content: Hi all, here's a thread to discuss this commitment scheme PR: https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/766. I avoided the thorny bit which is computational notions of binding, but without that of course we can prove the non-existence of statistically hiding schemes (of < 1 error) which are perfectly binding. Based it on Boneh-Shoup.
@Wrenna Robson would you be willing to take a look at this?
